Action: look at bowl 2

data.provenance: Decisive turn window [9,9] from trajectory alfworld_133 (10 turns); steps are verbatim conversation turns, not tool calls — turn-based SFT corpus.

data.description: [OTHER] 71 of 3,119 expert trajectories (2.3%) terminate on an action outside the harness grammar (look 54, examine 15, think 1, quickly 1). 69 of the 71 are look_at_obj_in_light tasks where the expert invents 'look at X [under desklamp]' / 'examine X with desklamp' instead of any documented action. Two non-look_at cases (alfworld_1263 'think of a new approach', alfworld_3325 'quickly scan the room') end mid-search with no task-completing action. Where pseudo-actions are non-terminal, the environment fabricates free-form observations for them (alfworld_3325 turn 82) instead of the documented invalid-action response — the prompt's exact string 'Nothing happened' appears ZERO times in any observation turn across all 3,119 trajectories despite 280 terminal + 80 non-terminal out-of-prompt-grammar actions. The observation stream is therefore not stock ALFWorld behavior for invalid inputs. (Note: 209 further terminals use 'use desklamp 1', absent from the prompt but accepted by this harness build — 'You turn on the desklamp 1.' — so the reviewer's verb list is the harness grammar, not the prompt's literal list.)
